question: Should omitted `plugins.entries.active-memory.config.agents` remain fail-closed, or become an implicit allowlist of every configured agent with `main` as the minimal-config fallback?
rationale: Both contracts are technically implementable, but changing omission activates model-backed memory behavior for existing configurations and therefore requires explicit ownership of compatibility, cost, latency, and personalization consequences.

options.title: Preserve explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep omission fail-closed and address single-agent setup or command confusion through explicit onboarding/configuration and diagnostics.

options.title: Approve inherited targeting
options.body: Accept automatic configured-agent targeting after adding upgrade guidance and direct live proof for omitted and explicit-empty configurations.

options.title: Add an explicit all-agents mode
options.body: Retain omission semantics and introduce a separately approved explicit representation for dynamically targeting configured agents.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep omission fail-closed and address single-agent setup or command confusion through explicit onboarding/configuration and diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and much of its current runtime contract trace to this contributor's merged work.
